about: The VisIVO VR headset app (issue #255): the backend's VR page packaged as an immersive Horizon OS app. Read by build.sh / make-twa.py; the packages must match backend/app/vr_app.json. Bump versionCode whenever the wrapper changes (a new Bubblewrap, a new patch, a new icon; the icons are made by make-icons.py): the desktop reinstalls an app whose versionCode is lower than the one it ships.
